raw.query: WITH c AS (SELECT run_id, experiment, window_name, lead_s, MAX(CASE WHEN bound_ms=100 AND NOT is_violation THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS itl_pass, MAX(CASE WHEN bound_ms=1000 AND is_violation THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ttft_fail FROM v_infraction WHERE is_current AND pool='language' AND policy='reactive' GROUP BY run_id, experiment, window_name, lead_s HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c WHERE itl_pass=1 AND ttft_fail=1
raw.claimed: fourteen language-pool configurations meet window-mean law (ITL-p99≤100ms clean) while violating tail SLA (TTFT-p99>1000ms)
raw.evidence: DB count is 7, not 14 — exactly half. 41 language reactive TTFT-violating runs exist; only 7 also pass ITL. g4 alone has 7 runs (14 SLA rows) but only 4/7 violate tail, so 'fourteen' fits neither distinct configs nor g4-specific runs.
raw.fix: Change 'fourteen' to 'seven' or qualify: 'seven of the language-pool configurations — representing all whole-trace aggregate runs and 4/7 g4 sweep variants — meet their own window-mean law while violating the tail SLA.'
